skills.name: mintlify
skills.description: Set up, write, and publish documentation sites with Mintlify, and work on existing Mintlify projects. Use when the user wants to create a docs site for a repo or product, turn a docs/ folder or README into a hosted docs site, document an API from an OpenAPI spec, migrate docs from Docusaurus, GitBook, ReadMe, Fern, or another platform, preview docs locally, or publish docs to a shareable URL. Also use when editing a project with docs.json, including pages, navigation, components, API references, and customizing appearance or browser behavior with CSS, JavaScript, React, and snippets.
